purpose: Held-out full-catalogue recovery census, exploratory engineering follow-up; success criteria fixed before full execution

success.failures_and_missing_cases: Count as nonwins; any unexpected recovery failure fails the exactness gate
success.direct_control: Report every outcome; DVC wins alone do not establish superiority over all recovery engines

scope: Census of this finite authored catalogue, not an estimate that recovery is faster in 90% of production deployments. Repeated trials and related histories are not independent populations.
dvc_strengthening: Optimal identical paid payloads; selection free
Empty requested-output directory before each trial
Retained cache objects hard-linked to paid payloads; all other cache removed
checkout when all requested files retained, otherwise one exact-request batch repro
Warm API imports excluded equally, per-request Repo construction included
Both custom workers share the selective retained-file fast path
timing: Median elapsed time including requested-output SHA256 verification. Setup and cache preparation excluded; all raw repetitions and failures retained. No OS cache flush.
